text:
Maya B. (Sales): Passing AcmeHealth to CS/support — quick summary: private (VPC) deployment, HIPAA scope, SAML SSO, want dedicated pool for production. Trial window target: 2025-04-04. They saw latency spikes during a 80 QPS synthetic run. Renewal flagged by CFO given cost concerns. Owners: Sarah L. (CS) primary, John P. (Eng) for private deploy/perf. Can CS confirm onboarding checklist and call out infra blockers?

Sarah L. (CS): Got it, thanks Maya. I'll own onboarding. Quick Qs: do they require HSM for key storage or is KMS OK? Who's the SAML IdP POC and can we get metadata/scim creds? Also need the prompt set + target SLOs.

Maya B. (Sales): No HSM, KMS only. POC is it-team@acme.co (cc'ed). Prompt set is in the eval bundle: https://s3.company/acme/evals/promptset_v2.json. Target SLOs: p50 <250ms, p95 <600ms at 40 QPS sustained. Renewal risk: they want a cost delta for staging vs prod (quantized vs fp16).

Alex R. (Support): I can own SCIM + SSO once we have idp metadata. I'll open a support ticket and add the checklist items.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4321 created: "AcmeHealth private deploy onboarding: SSO, dedicated, latency tuning" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4321

John P. (Eng): Quick infra context — model is 7B, q4f16 quantized (~12GB resident w/ KV cache). If they want 40 QPS with ~2k token averages we need autoscale + batching. Proposed plan:
1) Provision staging Dedicated pool (instance class f1), 2 replicas for stability.
2) Run load test with ab-runner: 
```
ab-runner --model gpt-7b-q4f16 --seq 2048 --qps 40 --concurrency 8
```
3) Enable prefix caching + set min_batch=4.
I'll create an eng ticket for the private-deploy template and network checklist.

Sarah L. (CS): Thanks John — timeline suggestion: staging provision by 2025-03-28, SSO demo 2025-04-02, prod trial kickoff 2025-04-04. I will own customer comms and run the kick-off.

Maya B. (Sales): :thumbsup: please call out any blockers (network, cert windows, cert rotation). Also they want the cost delta for q4f16 vs fp16 for both pre-prod and prod.

John P. (Eng): Short cost note: q4f16 reduces VRAM footprint and increases effective batch size — expect ~25-35% GPU cost reduction depending on latency needs. I'll add recommended quant profiles and perf numbers to CS-4321.

Sarah L. (CS): Owners (added to ticket comments):
- Sarah L. (CS) — onboarding lead
- John P. (Eng) — private deploy & perf tuning
- Alex R. (Support) — SSO/SCIM integration
- Maya B. (Sales) — commercial owner
Next steps: upload prompt set to shared drive, customer to complete security questionnaire, schedule kick-off calendar invite.

Alex R. (Support): IdP metadata placeholder added to CS-4321 comments. Please attach real metadata when you have it.

Maya B. (Sales): I'll send IdP metadata and SCIM creds by EOD tomorrow.

Sarah L. (CS): Got it. If eng wants eval traces / run logs I can attach the latency traces and examples to the ticket. :raised_hands:

John P. (Eng): If we hit higher seq lengths we may need to bump replica counts or enable KV offload. I'll monitor after staging runs.

Sarah L. (CS): I'll schedule a 30m kick-off for 2025-03-29 and invite owners.

Maya B. (Sales): Thanks team — please update CS-4321 with any blockers.

Sarah L. (CS): Will do. Closing thread for now, will post post-kickoff notes in CS-4321.
